hooks.command: bash -c 'URL="${DATABASE_URL:-}"; if [ -n "$URL" ] && [ "${CLAUDE_SAFE_DB:-}" != "1" ]; then printf "{\"continue\":false,\"stopReason\":\"Production DB protection: DATABASE_URL is set without CLAUDE_SAFE_DB=1. Claude cannot run commands against the production database. If this is your dev database, add CLAUDE_SAFE_DB=1 to your .env.local.\"}"; exit 1; fi'
